title.zh: 卷一百九十六 列傳第八十三: 忠義四
title.en: Volume 196 Biographies 83: Loyal and Righteous Acts 4
title.raw: 卷一百九十六 列傳第八十三: 忠義四 Volume 196 Biographies 83: Loyal and Righteous Acts 4

sentences.zh: 普顏不花，字希古，蒙古氏。

translations.literal: Puyan Buhua, style name Xigu, was of the Mongol clan.
translations.idiomatic: Puyan Buhua, whose style name was Xigu, was a Mongol.

sentences.zh: 倜儻有大志。

translations.literal: He was unconventional and had great ambition.
translations.idiomatic: Free-spirited and ambitious, he aimed high from the start.

sentences.zh: 至正五年，由國子生登右榜進士第一人，授翰林修撰，調河南行省員外郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhizheng, as a National University student he placed first among the right-board jinshi, was appointed Hanlin reviser, and was transferred to vice director of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1345, as a student of the National University he took first place on the right-board jinshi examination. He was appointed Hanlin reviser and transferred to vice director in the Henan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷江西行省左右司郎中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was transferred to director of the left and right bureaus of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1351 he was transferred to director of the left and right secretariat bureaus in the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 蘄黃徐壽輝來寇，普顏不花戰守之功為多，語在《道童傳》。

translations.literal: When Xu Shouhui of Qihuang came raiding, Puyan Buhua's achievements in fighting and defense were the greatest; the account is in the 《Biography of Daotong》.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Shouhui of Qihuang invaded, Puyan Buhua bore the brunt of the fighting and defense; the full account appears in the 《Biography of Daotong》.

sentences.zh: 十六年，除江西廉訪副使。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was appointed vice surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1356 he was appointed vice surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 頃之，召還，授益都路達魯花赤，遷山東廉訪使，再轉為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Before long he was recalled, appointed darughachi of Yidu Circuit, promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shandong, and again transferred to associate administration councilor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was recalled and appointed darughachi of Yidu Circuit, then promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shandong and finally transferred to associate administration councilor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十八年，詔與治書侍御史李國鳳同經略江南。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, he was ordered together with Supervising Secretary Li Guofeng to oversee military affairs in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1358 he was ordered, together with Supervising Secretary Li Guofeng, to oversee military affairs in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 至建寧，江西陳友諒遣鄧克明來寇，而平章政事阿魯溫沙等皆夜遁。

translations.literal: When he reached Jianning, Chen Youliang of Jiangxi sent Deng Keming to attack, while the chief councillors Aru Wensha and others all fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching Jianning, he found that Chen Youliang of Jiangxi had sent Deng Keming to attack, while Chief Councillors Aru Wensha and the rest had all fled under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 國鳳時分鎮延平，城陷，遁去。

translations.literal: Li Guofeng was then stationed separately at Yanping; when the city fell he fled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guofeng was then holding Yanping separately; when that city fell he fled as well.

sentences.zh: 普顏不花曰：「我承制來此，去將何之？

translations.literal: Puyan Buhua said, "I came here by imperial order—where would I go if I left?
translations.idiomatic: Puyan Buhua said, "I came here on imperial commission. Where would I go if I left?

sentences.zh: 誓與此城同存亡耳。

translations.literal: I swear to live and die with this city."
translations.idiomatic: I swear to live and die with this city."

sentences.zh: 」命築各門甕城，前後拒戰六十四日，既而大敗賊眾。

translations.literal: " He ordered barbicans built at each gate, fought off the enemy for sixty-four days in all, and then inflicted a great defeat on the rebel forces.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered barbicans built at every gate and held the enemy off for sixty-four days in all, then inflicted a crushing defeat on the rebel army.

sentences.zh: 明年，召還，授山東宣慰使，再轉知樞密院事、平章山東行省，守禦益都。

translations.literal: The next year he was recalled, appointed pacification commissioner of Shandong, again transferred to privy council vice director and chief councillor of the Shandong Branch Secretariat, and charged with defending Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was recalled and appointed pacification commissioner of Shandong, then transferred again to privy council vice director and chief councillor of the Shandong Branch Secretariat, with responsibility for defending Yidu.

sentences.zh: 大明兵壓境，普顏不花捍城力戰。

translations.literal: When the Ming army pressed the borders, Puyan Buhua defended the city and fought hard.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces pressed the frontier, Puyan Buhua held the city and fought with all his strength.

sentences.zh: 城陷，而平章政事保保出降。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Chief Councillor Baobao went out and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Chief Councillor Baobao went out and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 普顏不花還告其母曰：「兒忠孝不能兩全，有二弟，當為終養。

translations.literal: Puyan Buhua returned and told his mother, "A son cannot fulfill both loyalty and filial piety at once. I have two younger brothers who should provide for you in your old age.
translations.idiomatic: Puyan Buhua went home and told his mother, "A man cannot fulfill both loyalty and filial piety at once. I have two younger brothers who should see to your care in old age.

sentences.zh: 」拜母，趨官舍，坐堂上。

translations.literal: " He bowed to his mother, hurried to the government compound, and sat in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed to his mother, hurried to the government compound, and took his seat in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 主將素聞其賢，召之再三，不往。

translations.literal: The commander had long heard of his worth and summoned him again and again, but he would not go.
translations.idiomatic: The commander had long heard of his worth and summoned him repeatedly, but he would not go.

sentences.zh: 既而面縛之，普顏不花曰：「我元朝進士，官至極品，臣各為其主。

translations.literal: Before long they bound him face to face. Puyan Buhua said, "I am a jinshi of the Yuan dynasty, risen to the highest rank—a minister serves his own lord.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they bound him and brought him forward. Puyan Buhua said, "I am a Yuan jinshi who rose to the highest rank. A minister serves his own lord.

sentences.zh: 」不屈，死之。

translations.literal: " He would not submit and was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: " He would not yield and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 先是，其妻阿魯真，歷呼家人告之曰：「我夫受國恩，我亦封齊國夫人，今事至此，唯有死耳。

translations.literal: Earlier, his wife Aru Zhen had called out to the household one by one and told them, "My husband has received the state's grace, and I too have been enfeoffed as Lady of Qi. Now that matters have come to this, there is nothing but death.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, his wife Aru Zhen had summoned the household one by one and said, "My husband has received the state's grace, and I too was enfeoffed as Lady of Qi. Now that matters have come to this, there is nothing left but death.

sentences.zh: 」家人莫不嘆息泣下。

translations.literal: " The household all sighed and wept.
translations.idiomatic: " The whole household sighed and wept.

sentences.zh: 已而普顏不花二弟之妻，各抱幼子，及婢妾，溺舍南井死。

translations.literal: Before long the wives of Puyan Buhua's two younger brothers, each holding an infant son, together with maidservants and concubines, drowned themselves in the south well of the residence.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the wives of Puyan Buhua's two younger brothers, each clutching an infant son, together with maidservants and concubines, drowned themselves in the south well of the residence.

sentences.zh: 比阿魯真欲下，而井填咽不可容，遂抱子投舍北井。

translations.literal: When Aru Zhen was about to go down, the well was choked full and could hold no more, so she embraced her son and threw herself into the north well of the residence.
translations.idiomatic: When Aru Zhen was about to follow, the well was already choked full and could hold no more, so she clasped her son and threw herself into the north well of the residence.

sentences.zh: 其女及妾女、孫女，皆隨溺焉。

translations.literal: His daughter, the daughters of concubines, and granddaughters all drowned with them.
translations.idiomatic: His daughter, the daughters of concubines, and granddaughters all drowned as well.

sentences.zh: 是時有申榮者，平章山東行省，守東昌，榮見列郡皆降，告其父曰：「人生世間，不能全忠孝者，兒也。

translations.literal: At this time there was Shen Rong, chief councillor of the Shandong Branch Secretariat, defending Dongchang. When Rong saw that the neighboring prefectures had all surrendered, he told his father, "In this life, if one cannot fulfill both loyalty and filial piety, that person is his son.
translations.idiomatic: At this time there was Shen Rong, chief councillor of the Shandong Branch Secretariat, defending Dongchang. When Rong saw that the neighboring prefectures had all surrendered, he told his father, "In this life, if a man cannot fulfill both loyalty and filial piety, that man is his son.

sentences.zh: 」父曰：「何為？

translations.literal: " His father said, "What do you mean?
translations.idiomatic: " His father asked, "What do you mean?

sentences.zh: 」榮曰：「城中兵少不敵，戰則萬人之命由兒而廢，但有一死報國耳。

translations.literal: " Rong said, "The troops in the city are few and cannot match the enemy. If we fight, the lives of ten thousand people will be ruined because of me. I have only one death with which to repay the state."
translations.idiomatic: " Rong said, "The garrison is too small to match the enemy. If we fight, ten thousand lives will be ruined because of me. I have only one death with which to repay the state."

sentences.zh: 」遂自經。

translations.literal: " He then hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: " He then hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 閔本，字宗先，河內人。

translations.literal: Min Ben, style name Zongxian, was a native of Henei.
translations.idiomatic: Min Ben, whose style name was Zongxian, was from Henei.

sentences.zh: 性剛正敏給，而刻志於學。

translations.literal: By nature he was upright, forthright, and quick, and he devoted himself zealously to learning.
translations.idiomatic: Upright, forthright, and quick-witted by nature, he devoted himself zealously to learning.

sentences.zh: 早歲得推擇為禮部令史，御史大夫不花奇本之才，辟以為掾，平反冤獄，甚有聲。

translations.literal: In his early years he was selected as a clerk in the Ministry of Rites. Censor-in-chief Buhua admired Ben's talent and recruited him as an aide; he reversed wrongful convictions and gained great renown.
translations.idiomatic: In his early years he was selected as a clerk in the Ministry of Rites. Censor-in-chief Buhua admired his talent and recruited him as an aide; he reversed wrongful convictions and won wide renown.

sentences.zh: 擢御史臺照磨。

translations.literal: He was promoted to registrar of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to registrar of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 頃之，遷樞密院都事，拜監察御史，遷中書左司都事，五轉為吏部尚書，移刑、戶二部，皆以能見稱。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to director of the Privy Council, appointed investigating censor, transferred to director of the left bureau of the Central Secretariat, promoted five times to Minister of Personnel, and moved to the Ministries of Justice and Revenue—all on account of his ability.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to director of the Privy Council, appointed investigating censor, then director of the left secretariat bureau of the Central Secretariat. After five promotions he became Minister of Personnel and later moved to the Ministries of Justice and Revenue, earning praise for his ability at every step.

sentences.zh: 本素貧，且有目疾，嘗上章乞謝事，不允，詔授集賢侍講學士。

translations.literal: Ben had always been poor and also suffered from an eye ailment. He once submitted a memorial requesting to retire, but it was not granted; he was ordered appointed attendant academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Ben had always been poor and also suffered from an eye ailment. He once submitted a memorial asking to retire, but permission was denied; instead he was appointed attendant academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

sentences.zh: 大明兵薄京師，本謂其妻程氏曰：「國事至此，吾知之久矣。

translations.literal: When the Ming army pressed close to the capital, Ben said to his wife Lady Cheng, "The affairs of state have come to this—I have known it would for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces pressed close to the capital, Ben said to his wife Lady Cheng, "The affairs of state have come to this—I have known it would for a long time.

sentences.zh: 愧不能立功補報，敢愛六尺軀苟活哉！

translations.literal: I am ashamed that I could not establish merit to repay the debt—how dare I cherish this six-foot frame and cling to life!
translations.idiomatic: I am ashamed that I could not achieve anything to repay the debt—how dare I cherish this body and cling to life!

sentences.zh: 」程氏曰：「君能死忠，我尚有愛於君乎！

translations.literal: " Lady Cheng said, "If you can die in loyalty, do I still have any attachment to life!"
translations.idiomatic: " Lady Cheng said, "If you can die in loyalty, do I still have any attachment to life!"

sentences.zh: 」本乃朝服，與程氏北向再拜，大​​書於屋壁曰：「元中奉大夫、集賢侍講學士閔本死。

translations.literal: " Ben then put on court dress, and together with Lady Cheng bowed twice facing north. He wrote large characters on the wall of the house: "Min Ben, Yuan dynasty recipient of the rank of Supporter of the Court, attendant academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, is dead.
translations.idiomatic: " Ben then put on court dress, and together with Lady Cheng bowed twice facing north. He wrote in large characters on the wall: "Min Ben, Yuan recipient of the rank of Supporter of the Court and attendant academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, is dead.

sentences.zh: 」遂各縊焉。

translations.literal: " They then each hanged themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " They then each hanged themselves.

sentences.zh: 二女：長真真，次女女，見本死，呼天號泣，亦自縊於其傍。

translations.literal: His two daughters—the elder Zhenzhen and the younger Nünu—seeing Ben dead, cried out to heaven and wept, and also hanged themselves beside him.
translations.idiomatic: His two daughters—the elder Zhenzhen and the younger Nünu—seeing him dead, cried out to heaven and wept, and hanged themselves beside him as well.

sentences.zh: 有拜住者，康里人也，字聞善。

translations.literal: There was one Baizhu, a man of the Kangli people, whose style name was Wenshan.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Baizhu, a Kangli, whose style name was Wenshan.

sentences.zh: 以材累官至翰林國史院都事，為太子司經。

translations.literal: Through his talent he rose by stages to director of the Hanlin National History Academy and served as tutor to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Through his talent he rose by stages to director of the Hanlin National History Academy and served as tutor to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 兵至，拜住謂家人曰：「吾始祖海藍伯封河東公者，與太祖同事王可汗，太祖取王可汗，收諸部落，吾祖引數十騎馳西北方，太祖使人追問之，曰：'昔者與皇帝同事王可汗，王可汗今已滅，欲為之報仇，則帝乃天命；

translations.literal: When the army arrived, Baizhu said to his household, "My founding ancestor Hailanbo, enfeoffed as Duke of Hedong, served the First Emperor together with Wang Khan. When the First Emperor took Wang Khan and gathered the tribes, my ancestor led several dozen horsemen and galloped off to the northwest. The First Emperor sent men to pursue and question him. He said, 'In former days I served the Emperor together with Wang Khan. Wang Khan is now destroyed. If I wished to avenge him, the Emperor is Heaven's mandate;
translations.idiomatic: When the army arrived, Baizhu said to his household, "My founding ancestor Hailanbo, enfeoffed as Duke of Hedong, had served the First Emperor together with Wang Khan. When the First Emperor defeated Wang Khan and gathered the tribes, my ancestor led several dozen horsemen and galloped off to the northwest. The First Emperor sent men in pursuit to question him. He said, 'In former days I served the Emperor together with Wang Khan. Wang Khan is now destroyed. If I wished to avenge him, the Emperor holds Heaven's mandate;

sentences.zh: 欲改事帝，則吾心有所不忍，故避之於遠地，以沒吾生耳。

translations.literal: if I wished to turn and serve the Emperor, my heart could not bear it. Therefore I withdrew to a distant place to end my life there.'
translations.idiomatic: if I wished to turn and serve the Emperor, my heart could not bear it. Therefore I withdrew to a distant land to end my days there.'

sentences.zh: '此吾祖之言也。

translations.literal: These were my ancestor's words.
translations.idiomatic: These were my ancestor's words.

sentences.zh: 且吾祖生朔漠，其言尚如此，今吾生長中原，讀書國學，而可不知大義乎！

translations.literal: Moreover, my ancestor was born in the northern deserts, yet his words were still such as this. Now I was raised in the Central Plains and studied at the National University—how can I not know the great principle!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, my ancestor was born on the northern steppe, yet even his words were such as this. I was raised in the Central Plains and studied at the National University—how can I not know what duty requires!

sentences.zh: 況吾上世受國厚恩，至吾又食祿，今其國破，尚忍見之！

translations.literal: Moreover, my forebears received the state's deep grace, and I too have drawn salary. Now that the state is broken, how can I still bear to witness it!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, my forebears received the state's deep grace, and I too have drawn salary from it. Now that the state is broken, how can I still bear to witness it!

sentences.zh: 與其苟生，不如死。

translations.literal: Rather than live in degradation, it is better to die.
translations.idiomatic: Better to die than to live on in degradation.

sentences.zh: 」遂赴井死。

translations.literal: " He then threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He then threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 其家人瘞之舍東，悉以其書籍焚之為殉云。

translations.literal: His household buried him east of the residence and burned all his books as funerary offerings.
translations.idiomatic: His household buried him east of the residence and burned all his books as funerary offerings.

sentences.zh: 趙弘毅，字仁卿，真定晉州人。

translations.literal: Zhao Hongyi, style name Renqing, was a native of Jizhou in Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hongyi, whose style name was Renqing, was from Jizhou in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 少好學，家貧無書，傭於巨室，晝則為役，夜則藉書讀之。

translations.literal: From youth he loved learning. His family was poor and had no books; he hired himself out to a great household, working by day and borrowing books to read by night.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved learning. His family was poor and owned no books, so he hired himself out to a wealthy household, working by day and borrowing books to read by night.

sentences.zh: 或閔其志，但使總其事而不役焉。

translations.literal: Someone who pitied his resolve had him oversee affairs without being put to menial labor.
translations.idiomatic: Someone who admired his resolve had him oversee affairs without being put to menial labor.

sentences.zh: 嘗受經於臨川吳澄。

translations.literal: He once received the classics from Wu Cheng of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He once studied the classics under Wu Cheng of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 始辟翰林書寫，再轉為國史院編修官，調大樂署令。

translations.literal: He was first recruited as a Hanlin scribe, transferred again to compiler of the National History Academy, and reassigned as director of the Grand Music Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was first recruited as a Hanlin scribe, then transferred to compiler of the National History Academy and reassigned as director of the Grand Music Office.

sentences.zh: 大明兵入京城，弘毅嘆息曰；

translations.literal: When the Ming army entered the capital, Hongyi sighed and said:
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces entered the capital, Hongyi sighed and said:

sentences.zh: 「忠臣不二君，烈女不二夫，此古語也。

translations.literal: "A loyal minister does not serve two lords; a chaste woman does not take two husbands—this is an ancient saying.
translations.idiomatic: "A loyal minister does not serve two lords; a chaste woman does not take two husbands—so the ancients said.

sentences.zh: 我今力不能救社稷，但有一死報國耳。

translations.literal: Today I lack the strength to save the altars of state; I have only one death with which to repay the state."
translations.idiomatic: Today I lack the strength to save the altars of state. I have only one death with which to repay it."

sentences.zh: 」乃與妻解氏皆自縊。

translations.literal: " He and his wife Lady Xie then both hanged themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " He and his wife Lady Xie then both hanged themselves.

sentences.zh: 其子恭，中書管勾，與妻子訣曰：「今乘輿北奔，我父子食祿，不能效尺寸力，吾父母已死，尚何敢愛死乎！

translations.literal: His son Gong, a registry clerk of the Central Secretariat, took leave of his wife and children and said, "Now the imperial carriage flees north. My father and I have drawn salary yet could not render even the slightest service. My parents are already dead—how dare I still cling to life!
translations.idiomatic: His son Gong, a registry clerk of the Central Secretariat, took leave of his wife and children and said, "Now the imperial carriage flees north. My father and I have drawn salary yet could not render even the slightest service. My parents are already dead—how dare I still cling to life!

sentences.zh: 」或止之曰：「我曹官卑，何自苦如此。

translations.literal: " Someone tried to stop him, saying, "Our offices are low—why torment yourself like this."
translations.idiomatic: " Someone tried to stop him, saying, "Our offices are low—why torment yourself like this."

sentences.zh: 」恭叱曰：「爾非我徒也。

translations.literal: " Gong rebuked him, saying, "You are not of my company.
translations.idiomatic: " Gong rebuked him: "You are not of my company.

sentences.zh: 古者，忠義人各儘自心，豈問職之崇卑乎！

translations.literal: In antiquity, men of loyalty and righteousness each fulfilled their own hearts—did they ask whether their office was high or low!
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, men of loyalty and righteousness each gave what their hearts required—did they ask whether their office was high or low!

sentences.zh: 」遂公服北向再拜，亦縊死。

translations.literal: " He then put on official dress, bowed twice facing north, and hanged himself as well.
translations.idiomatic: " He then put on official dress, bowed twice facing north, and hanged himself as well.

sentences.zh: 恭女官奴，年十七，見恭死，方大泣，適鄰嫗數輩來，相率出避，曰：「我未適人，避將何之？

translations.literal: Gong's daughter Guannu, seventeen years old, seeing Gong dead, was weeping bitterly when several neighboring old women came and urged her to flee together. She said, "I am not yet married—where would I flee?
translations.idiomatic: Gong's daughter Guannu, seventeen years old, was weeping bitterly over his body when several neighboring old women came and urged her to flee with them. She said, "I am not yet married—where would I flee?

sentences.zh: 」不聽，嫗欲力挽之，女曰：「人生在世，便百歲亦須一死。

translations.literal: " She would not listen. When the old women tried to pull her away by force, the girl said, "In human life, even at a hundred years one must still die once.
translations.idiomatic: " She would not listen. When the old women tried to pull her away by force, she said, "In human life, even at a hundred years one must still die once.

sentences.zh: 」乃潛入中堂，解衣帶自經。

translations.literal: " She then slipped into the central hall, untied her sash, and hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: " She then slipped into the central hall, untied her sash, and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 鄭玉，字子美，徽州歙縣人。

translations.literal: Zheng Yu, style name Zimei, was a native of She County in Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yu, whose style name was Zimei, was from She County in Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 幼敏悟嗜學，既長，覃思《六經》，尤邃於《春秋》，絕意仕進，而勤於教。

translations.literal: From childhood he was keen and fond of learning. When grown, he pondered deeply the Six Classics and was especially accomplished in the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》. He set aside all thought of office and devoted himself to teaching.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he was quick and fond of learning. When grown, he pondered deeply the Six Classics and was especially accomplished in the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》. He set aside all thought of office and devoted himself to teaching.

sentences.zh: 學者門人受業者眾，所居至不能容。

translations.literal: Scholars and disciples who received instruction from him were many; his dwelling could no longer hold them.
translations.idiomatic: So many scholars and disciples came to study with him that his dwelling could no longer hold them all.

sentences.zh: 學者相與即其地構師山書院以處焉。

translations.literal: The scholars together built the Shishan Academy on that site to house them.
translations.idiomatic: The scholars together built the Shishan Academy on that site to house them.

sentences.zh: 玉為文章，不事雕刻煅煉，流傳京師，揭徯斯、歐陽玄咸加稱賞。

translations.literal: Yu wrote essays without pursuing elaborate polish. When they circulated in the capital, Jie Xisi and Ouyang Xuan all praised them highly.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's essays avoided elaborate polish. When they circulated in the capital, Jie Xisi and Ouyang Xuan both praised them highly.

sentences.zh: 至正十四年，朝廷除玉翰林待制、奉議大夫，遣使者賜以御酒名幣，浮海征之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhizheng, the court appointed Yu Hanlin attendant compiler and Gentleman for Discussion, sent envoys bearing imperial wine and famous silks, and summoned him by sea.
translations.idiomatic: In 1354 the court appointed Yu Hanlin attendant compiler and Gentleman for Discussion, sent envoys bearing imperial wine and famous silks, and summoned him by sea.

sentences.zh: 玉辭疾不起，而為表以進曰：「名爵者，祖宗之所以遺陛下，​​使與天下賢者共之者，陛下不得私予人。

translations.literal: Yu declined on grounds of illness and did not rise, but submitted a memorial saying, "Titles and offices are what the ancestors bequeathed to Your Majesty to share with worthy men throughout the realm. Your Majesty may not bestow them privately.
translations.idiomatic: Yu pleaded illness and did not go, but submitted a memorial saying, "Titles and offices are what the ancestors bequeathed to Your Majesty to share with worthy men throughout the realm. Your Majesty may not bestow them privately.

sentences.zh: 待制之職，臣非其才，不敢受。

translations.literal: The post of attendant compiler—I lack the talent for it and dare not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: As for the post of attendant compiler, I lack the talent for it and dare not accept it.

sentences.zh: 酒與幣，天下所以奉陛下，陛下得以私與人，酒與幣，臣不敢辭也。

translations.literal: Wine and silks are what the realm offers Your Majesty; Your Majesty may give them privately to others. As for wine and silks, I dare not decline.
translations.idiomatic: Wine and silks are what the realm offers Your Majesty, and Your Majesty may give them privately to others. As for wine and silks, I dare not decline.

sentences.zh: 」玉既不仕，則家居，日以著書為事，所著有《周易纂注》。

translations.literal: " Since Yu would not take office, he remained at home and devoted his days to writing. Among his works was the 《Collected Commentary on the Book of Changes》.
translations.idiomatic: " Since Yu would not take office, he remained at home and devoted his days to writing. Among his works was the 《Collected Commentary on the Book of Changes》.

sentences.zh: 十七年，大明兵入徽州，守將將要致之，玉曰：「吾豈事二姓者耶！

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, when the Ming army entered Huizhou, the defending commander was about to deliver him up. Yu said, "Would I serve two dynasties!
translations.idiomatic: In 1357, when Ming forces entered Huizhou, the defending commander was about to hand him over. Yu said, "Would I serve two dynasties!

sentences.zh: 」因被拘囚。

translations.literal: " He was therefore imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: " He was therefore imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 久之，親戚朋友攜具餉之，則從容為之盡歡，且告以必死狀。

translations.literal: After a long while, relatives and friends brought food and drink to offer him. He then received them at ease and made merry, and told them he would certainly die.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while, relatives and friends brought food and drink to visit him. He received them at ease and made merry, and told them he would certainly die.

sentences.zh: 其妻聞之，使語之曰：「君苟死，吾其相從地下矣。

translations.literal: When his wife heard this, she sent word to him, saying, "If you are to die, I shall follow you beneath the earth.
translations.idiomatic: When his wife heard this, she sent word: "If you are to die, I shall follow you beneath the earth.

sentences.zh: 」玉使謂之曰：「若果從吾死，吾其無憾矣。

translations.literal: " Yu sent back word: "If you truly follow me in death, I shall have no regret.
translations.idiomatic: " Yu sent back word: "If you truly follow me in death, I shall have no regret.

sentences.zh: 」明日，具衣冠，北向再拜，自縊而死。

translations.literal: " The next day he put on cap and robes, bowed twice facing north, and hanged himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: " The next day he put on cap and robes, bowed twice facing north, and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 黃冔，字殷士，撫州金溪人。

translations.literal: Huang Fu, style name Yinshi, was a native of Jinxi in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Fu, whose style name was Yinshi, was from Jinxi in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 博學明經，善屬文，尤長於詩。

translations.literal: Broadly learned and versed in the classics, skilled in composition, and especially accomplished in poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly learned and versed in the classics, skilled in prose, and especially accomplished in poetry.

sentences.zh: 至正十七年，用左丞相太平奏，授淮南行省照磨，未行，除國子助教，遷太常博士，轉國子博士，升監丞，擢翰林待制，兼國史院編修官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Zhizheng, on the recommendation of Left Chancellor Taiping, he was appointed registrar of the Huainan Branch Secretariat. Before he took up the post he was appointed assistant instructor of the National University, transferred to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then erudite of the National University, promoted to supervisor, and elevated to Hanlin attendant compiler and concurrently compiler of the National History Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1357, on the recommendation of Left Chancellor Taiping, he was appointed registrar of the Huainan Branch Secretariat. Before he took up the post he was appointed assistant instructor of the National University, then erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then erudite of the National University, promoted to supervisor, and elevated to Hanlin attendant compiler and concurrently compiler of the National History Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，京城既破，冔歎曰：「我以儒致身，累蒙國恩，為冑子師，代言禁林。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, when the capital had fallen, Fu sighed and said, "I rose through Confucian learning and received the state's grace again and again. I was teacher to the crown prince's sons and spoke for the forbidden grove.
translations.idiomatic: In 1368, when the capital had fallen, Fu sighed and said, "I rose through Confucian learning and received the state's grace again and again. I was teacher to the crown prince's sons and spoke for the forbidden grove.

sentences.zh: 今縱無我戮，何面目見天下士乎！

translations.literal: Even if I am not put to death, with what face can I meet the scholars of the realm!
translations.idiomatic: Even if I am not put to death, with what face could I meet the scholars of the realm!

sentences.zh: 」遂赴井而死，年六十一。

translations.literal: " He then threw himself into a well and died, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: " He then threw himself into a well and died, aged sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 有詩文傳於世。

translations.literal: His poetry and prose have been handed down in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His poetry and prose have been handed down to posterity.

sentences.zh: 柏帖穆爾，字君壽，蒙古人。

translations.literal: Baitie Muer, style name Junshou, was a Mongol.
translations.idiomatic: Baitie Muer, whose style name was Junshou, was a Mongol.

sentences.zh: 家世歷履無所考。

translations.literal: His family's background and career cannot be traced.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing is known of his family's background or career.

sentences.zh: 居官所至，以廉能著聲。

translations.literal: Wherever he held office, he was renowned for integrity and ability.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he held office, he was renowned for integrity and ability.

sentences.zh: 至正中，累遷為福建行省左右司郎中。

translations.literal: During the Zhizheng reign he was promoted by stages to director of the left and right bureaus of the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhizheng reign he was promoted by stages to director of the left and right secretariat bureaus in the Fujian Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 行省治福州。

translations.literal: The branch secretariat was administered from Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The branch secretariat was administered from Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，大明以騎兵出杉關，取邵武，以舟師由海道趣閩，奄至城下。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the Ming sent cavalry out through Shan Pass, took Shaowu, and sent a naval force along the sea route toward Fujian, arriving suddenly beneath the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: In 1367 Ming cavalry marched out through Shan Pass and took Shaowu, while a naval force advanced along the coast toward Fujian and arrived suddenly beneath the city walls.

sentences.zh: 柏帖穆爾知城不可守，引妻妾坐樓上，慷慨謂曰：「丈夫死國，婦人死夫，義也。

translations.literal: Baitie Muer knew the city could not be held. He brought his wives and concubines to sit upstairs and said with feeling, "A man dies for his state; a woman dies for her husband—this is righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Baitie Muer knew the city could not be held. He brought his wives and concubines upstairs and said with feeling, "A man dies for his state; a woman dies for her husband—that is righteousness.

sentences.zh: 今城且陷，吾必死於是，若等能吾從乎？

translations.literal: Now the city is about to fall. I shall certainly die here—can you follow me?
translations.idiomatic: Now the city is about to fall. I shall certainly die here—will you follow me?

sentences.zh: 」皆泣曰：「有死而已，無他志也。

translations.literal: " They all wept and said, "There is only death—no other intent."
translations.idiomatic: " They all wept and said, "We ask only to die—nothing else."

sentences.zh: 」縊而死者六人。

translations.literal: " Six people hanged themselves and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Six of them hanged themselves and died.

sentences.zh: 有十歲女，度其不能自死，則紿之曰：「汝稽顙拜佛，庶保我無恙也。

translations.literal: He had a ten-year-old daughter. Judging that she could not kill herself, he deceived her, saying, "You kowtow and worship the Buddha—perhaps that will keep me unharmed."
translations.idiomatic: He had a ten-year-old daughter. Judging that she could not take her own life, he deceived her, saying, "Kowtow and worship the Buddha—that may keep me safe."

sentences.zh: 」甫拜，即挈米囊壓之死。

translations.literal: " As soon as she bowed, he seized a rice sack and pressed her to death with it.
translations.idiomatic: " The moment she bowed, he seized a rice sack and pressed her to death with it.

sentences.zh: 乳媼抱其幼子，旁立以泣，柏帖穆爾熟視之，歎曰：「父死國，母死夫，妾與女，從父者也，皆當死。

translations.literal: The wet nurse held his infant son and stood weeping at the side. Baitie Muer looked at them intently and sighed, saying, "The father dies for the state; the mother dies for her husband. Concubines and daughters follow the father—all ought to die.
translations.idiomatic: The wet nurse held his infant son and stood weeping nearby. Baitie Muer looked at them intently and sighed, saying, "The father dies for the state; the mother dies for her husband. Concubines and daughters follow the father—all ought to die.

sentences.zh: 汝三歲兒，於義何所從乎？

translations.literal: Your three-year-old son—by righteousness, whom should he follow?
translations.idiomatic: As for your three-year-old son—by righteousness, whom should he follow?

sentences.zh: 為宗祀計可也。

translations.literal: For the sake of ancestral sacrifice, he may be spared.
translations.idiomatic: For the sake of the ancestral line, he may be spared.

sentences.zh: 」乃命媼抱匿旁近民舍，而斂金珠畀之曰：「即有緩急，可以此贖兒命。

translations.literal: " He then ordered the nurse to take the child and hide in a nearby commoner's house, gathered gold and pearls, and gave them to her, saying, "If there is any emergency, you can use these to ransom the boy's life."
translations.idiomatic: " He then ordered the nurse to take the child and hide in a nearby commoner's house, gathered gold and pearls, and gave them to her, saying, "If trouble comes, use these to ransom the boy's life."

sentences.zh: 」有頃，兵入城，即舉燈自燃，四圍窗火大發，遂自焚死。

translations.literal: " Before long the army entered the city. He immediately raised a lamp and set himself afire; flames burst out all around the windows, and he burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long the army entered the city. He lit a lamp and set himself ablaze; flames burst from the windows on every side, and he burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 迭裡彌實，字子初，回回人。

translations.literal: Dielimishi, style name Zichu, was a Hui Muslim.
translations.idiomatic: Dielimishi, whose style name was Zichu, was a Hui Muslim.

sentences.zh: 性剛介，事母至孝。

translations.literal: By nature he was stern and upright, and served his mother with utmost filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Stern and upright by nature, he served his mother with utmost filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 年四十，猶不仕，或問之，曰：「吾不忍舍吾母以去也。

translations.literal: At forty he still would not take office. When someone asked him why, he said, "I cannot bear to leave my mother and go away."
translations.idiomatic: At forty he still would not take office. When someone asked why, he said, "I cannot bear to leave my mother."

sentences.zh: 」以宿衛年勞，授行宣政院崇教，三遷為漳州路達魯花赤，居三年，居甚安之。

translations.literal: " Through years of service in the imperial guard, he was appointed Chongjiao of the Traveling Office of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, promoted three times to darughachi of Zhangzhou Circuit, and after three years in office lived there in great ease.
translations.idiomatic: " Through years of service in the imperial guard, he was appointed Chongjiao of the Traveling Office of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs and promoted three times to darughachi of Zhangzhou Circuit. After three years in office he lived there in great contentment.

sentences.zh: 時陳有定據全閩，八郡之政，皆用其私人以總制之。

translations.literal: At this time Chen Youding held all of Fujian; the administration of the eight prefectures was entirely run by his private men as overseers.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Chen Youding held all of Fujian, and the administration of its eight prefectures was entirely controlled by his own men.

sentences.zh: 朝廷命官，不得有所與。

translations.literal: Officials appointed by the court could take no part in it.
translations.idiomatic: Officials appointed by the court could take no part in it.

sentences.zh: 大明兵既取福州，興化、泉州皆納款。

translations.literal: Once the Ming army had taken Fuzhou, Xinghua and Quanzhou both submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Once Ming forces had taken Fuzhou, Xinghua and Quanzhou both submitted.

sentences.zh: 或以告，迭裡彌實仰天歎曰：「吾不材，位三品，國恩厚矣，其何以報乎！

translations.literal: When someone told him this, Dielimishi looked up to heaven and sighed, saying, "I am without talent, yet hold third rank—the state's grace is deep. How can I repay it!
translations.idiomatic: When someone told him, Dielimishi looked up to heaven and sighed, saying, "I am without talent, yet hold third rank—the state's grace is deep. How can I repay it!

sentences.zh: 報國恩者，有死而已。

translations.literal: To repay the state's grace, there is only death.
translations.idiomatic: To repay the state's grace, there is only death.

sentences.zh: 」亡何，吏走白招諭使者至，請出城迓之，迭裡彌實從容語之曰：「爾第往，吾行出矣。

translations.literal: " Before long a clerk ran in reporting that pacification envoys had arrived and asking to go out of the city to welcome them. Dielimishi said calmly, "You go on ahead—I am about to go out."
translations.idiomatic: " Before long a clerk ran in reporting that pacification envoys had arrived and asking permission to go out and welcome them. Dielimishi said calmly, "You go on ahead—I am about to go out myself."

sentences.zh: 」乃詣廳事，具公服，北面再拜畢，引斧斫其印文，又大書手版曰「大元臣子」。

translations.literal: " He then went to the hall of affairs, put on official dress, bowed twice facing north, took an axe and chopped at the seal inscription, and wrote large characters on his name tablet: "Subject of the Great Yuan."
translations.idiomatic: " He then went to the hall of affairs, put on official dress, and bowed twice facing north. He took an axe and chopped at the seal inscription, then wrote in large characters on his name tablet: "Subject of the Great Yuan."

sentences.zh: 即入位端坐，拔所佩刀，剚喉中以死。

translations.literal: He then took his seat upright, drew the sword at his belt, and stabbed himself in the throat to die.
translations.idiomatic: He then took his seat upright, drew the sword at his belt, and stabbed himself in the throat.

sentences.zh: 既死，猶手執刀按膝坐，儼然如生時。

translations.literal: After death he still held the sword in his hand, resting it on his knee as he sat, looking exactly as in life.
translations.idiomatic: After death he still sat with the sword in his hand upon his knee, looking exactly as in life.

sentences.zh: 郡民相聚哭庭中，斂其屍，葬東門外。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture gathered and wept in the courtyard, prepared his body, and buried him outside the east gate.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture gathered and wept in the courtyard, prepared his body for burial, and interred him outside the east gate.

sentences.zh: 時又有獲獨步丁者，回回人，舊進士，累官僉廣東廉訪司事；

translations.literal: At this time there was also Huo Dubuding, a Hui Muslim and former jinshi, who had risen by stages to associate surveillance commissioner of Guangdong;
translations.idiomatic: At this time there was also Huo Dubuding, a Hui Muslim and former jinshi who had risen by stages to associate surveillance commissioner of Guangdong;

sentences.zh: 有呂复者，為江西行省左右司都事。

translations.literal: there was Lü Fu, who served as director of the left and right bureaus of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: and there was Lü Fu, director of the left and right secretariat bureaus in the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 皆閒居，寓福州。

translations.literal: Both were living in retirement, residing in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Both were living in retirement in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 而復以行省命，攝長樂縣尹。

translations.literal: Fu, by order of the branch secretariat, was acting as magistrate of Changle County.
translations.idiomatic: Fu, by order of the branch secretariat, was acting as magistrate of Changle County.

sentences.zh: 福州既下，獲獨步丁曰：「吾兄弟三人，皆忝進士，受國恩四十年，今雖無官守，然大節所在，其可辱乎！

translations.literal: When Fuzhou had fallen, Huo Dubuding said, "We three brothers have all been jinshi and received the state's grace for forty years. Though we now hold no office, the great principle is at stake—how can we endure disgrace!
translations.idiomatic: When Fuzhou fell, Huo Dubuding said, "We three brothers have all been jinshi and received the state's grace for forty years. Though we now hold no office, the great principle is at stake—how can we endure disgrace!

sentences.zh: 」以石自係其腰，投井死。

translations.literal: " He tied a stone to his waist and threw himself into a well to die.
translations.idiomatic: " He tied a stone to his waist and threw himself into a well.

sentences.zh: 复亦曰：「吾世食君祿，今雖攝官，若不以死報國，則無以見先人於地下。

translations.literal: Fu also said, "My family has eaten the ruler's salary for generations. Though I now hold only an acting post, if I do not repay the state with my death, I shall have no face to meet my ancestors beneath the earth."
translations.idiomatic: Fu also said, "My family has drawn salary from the throne for generations. Though I now hold only an acting post, if I do not repay the state with my death, how can I face my ancestors beneath the earth."

sentences.zh: 」引繩自經死。

translations.literal: " He took a rope and hanged himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: " He took a rope and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 獲獨步丁兄曰穆魯丁者，官建康；

translations.literal: Huo Dubuding's elder brother, called Muruding, held office in Jiankang;
translations.idiomatic: Huo Dubuding's elder brother Muruding had held office in Jiankang;

sentences.zh: 曰海魯丁者，官信州。

translations.literal: and one called Hairuding held office in Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: and his brother Hairuding had held office in Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 先是，亦皆死國難云。

translations.literal: Earlier, they too had all died in the state's calamity, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, it is said, they too had all died in the state's calamity.

sentences.zh: 樸賽因不花，字德中，肅良合台人。

translations.literal: Pusaiyin Buhua, style name Dezhong, was a man of the Sulianghetai people.
translations.idiomatic: Pusaiyin Buhua, whose style name was Dezhong, was from the Sulianghetai people.

sentences.zh: 有膂力，善騎射。

translations.literal: He had great physical strength and was skilled in horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built and skilled in horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 由速古兒赤授利器庫提點，再轉為資正院判官，累遷同知樞密院事，遷翰林學士，尋升承旨，賜虎符，兼巡軍合浦全羅等處軍民萬戶都元帥，除大司農，出為嶺北行省右丞，昇平章政事。

translations.literal: From the imperial guard he was appointed intendant of the Arsenal, transferred again to vice director of the Zizheng Court, promoted by stages to vice director of the Privy Council, transferred to Hanlin academician, soon elevated to Hanlin academician-in-ordinary, granted a tiger tally, and concurrently made commander-in-chief of the military and civilian households of Hepu, Jeolla, and other districts; appointed Minister of Agriculture, sent out as right vice councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, and promoted to chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: From the imperial guard he was appointed intendant of the Arsenal, then transferred to vice director of the Zizheng Court and promoted by stages to privy council vice director and Hanlin academician, soon elevated to Hanlin academician-in-ordinary. He was granted a tiger tally and concurrently made commander-in-chief over the military and civilian households of Hepu, Jeolla, and other districts, appointed Minister of Agriculture, sent out as right vice councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, and promoted to chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 至正二十四年，甘肅行省以孛羅帖木兒矯弒皇后、皇孫，遣人白事，平章政事也速答兒即欲署諭眾榜，樸賽因不花持不可曰： 「此大事，何得輕​​信，況非符驗公文。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhizheng, the Gansu Branch Secretariat reported that Bolu Temur had falsely murdered the empress and the imperial grandson, and sent someone to inform the court. Chief Councillor Yesudar immediately wished to sign a proclamation to the people. Pusaiyin Buhua held that this would not do and said, "This is a grave matter—how can it be lightly believed, especially when there is no verified official document."
translations.idiomatic: In 1364 the Gansu Branch Secretariat reported that Bolu Temur had falsely murdered the empress and the imperial grandson and sent someone to inform the court. Chief Councillor Yesudar immediately wished to sign a proclamation to the people. Pusaiyin Buhua objected, saying, "This is a grave matter—how can it be lightly believed, especially when there is no verified official document."

sentences.zh: 」卒不署榜。

translations.literal: " In the end he did not sign the proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he did not sign the proclamation.

sentences.zh: 既而果妄傳。

translations.literal: Before long it proved to be a false rumor.
translations.idiomatic: Before long it proved to be a false rumor.

sentences.zh: 會皇太子撫軍冀寧，承製拜樸賽因不花翰林學士承旨，遷集賢大學士，又為宣政院使，遂拜中書平章政事。

translations.literal: When the crown prince pacified the army in Jining, Pusaiyin Buhua was appointed by imperial order Hanlin academician-in-ordinary, transferred to grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, made commissioner of the Office of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and finally appointed chief councillor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince pacified the army in Jining, Pusaiyin Buhua was appointed by imperial order Hanlin academician-in-ordinary, transferred to grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, made commissioner of the Office of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and finally appointed chief councillor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大明兵逼京師，詔樸賽因不花以兵守順承門，其所領兵僅數百羸卒而已。

translations.literal: When the Ming army pressed the capital, Pusaiyin Buhua was ordered to hold Shuncheng Gate with troops; the force he commanded was only several hundred weak and weary soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces pressed the capital, Pusaiyin Buhua was ordered to hold Shuncheng Gate with troops—only several hundred weak and weary soldiers.

sentences.zh: 乃嘆息謂左右曰：「國事至此，吾但知與此門同存亡也。

translations.literal: He sighed and said to those beside him, "The affairs of state have come to this—I know only to live and die with this gate."
translations.idiomatic: He sighed and said to those beside him, "The affairs of state have come to this—I know only to live and die with this gate."

sentences.zh: 」城陷被執，以見主將，唯請速死，不少屈。

translations.literal: " When the city fell he was seized and brought before the commander. He asked only to die quickly and would not yield in the least.
translations.idiomatic: " When the city fell he was seized and brought before the commander. He asked only to die quickly and would not yield in the least.

sentences.zh: 主將命留營中，終不屈，殺之。

translations.literal: The commander ordered him kept in camp, but he never submitted and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: The commander ordered him kept in camp, but he never submitted and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 是時有張庸者，字存中，溫州人。

translations.literal: At this time there was Zhang Yong, style name Cunzhong, a native of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At this time there was Zhang Yong, whose style name was Cunzhong, from Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 性豪爽，精太乙數，會世亂，以策幹經略使李國鳳，承製授庸福建行省員外郎，治兵杉關。

translations.literal: By nature he was bold and generous and skilled in the art of Great Unity Numbers. When the age fell into disorder, he presented his plans to the frontier commissioner Li Guofeng and was appointed by imperial order vice director of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, charged with training troops at Shan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and generous by nature, he was skilled in the art of Great Unity Numbers. When the realm fell into disorder, he presented his plans to frontier commissioner Li Guofeng and was appointed by imperial order vice director of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, charged with training troops at Shan Pass.

sentences.zh: 頃之，計事赴京師，因進《太乙數圖》，順帝喜之，擢秘書少監。

translations.literal: Before long he went to the capital on business and presented the 《Chart of Great Unity Numbers》. Emperor Shundi was pleased and promoted him to vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he went to the capital on business and presented the 《Chart of Great Unity Numbers》. Emperor Shundi was pleased and promoted him to vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 皇太子立大撫軍院，命庸團結房山，遷同僉將作院事，又除刑部尚書，仍領團結。

translations.literal: The crown prince established the Great Pacification Army Bureau and ordered Yong to organize militia in Fangshan. He was transferred to associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, then appointed Minister of Justice while still leading the militia organization.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince established the Great Pacification Army Bureau and ordered Yong to organize militia in Fangshan. He was transferred to associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, then appointed Minister of Justice while still leading the militia organization.

sentences.zh: 會諸寨既降，庸守駱駝谷，遣從事段禎請援於擴廓帖木兒，不報。

translations.literal: When the various stockades had surrendered, Yong held Luotuo Valley and sent his aide Duan Zhen to request aid from Köke Temür, but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: When the various stockades had surrendered, Yong held Luotuo Valley and sent his aide Duan Zhen to request aid from Köke Temür, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 庸獨堅守拒戰，眾將潰，庸無去志。

translations.literal: Yong alone held firm and fought off the enemy. The other commanders broke and fled, but Yong had no thought of leaving.
translations.idiomatic: Yong alone held firm and fought on. The other commanders broke and fled, but he had no thought of leaving.

sentences.zh: 已而寨民李世傑執庸出降，以見主將，庸不屈，與禎同被殺。

translations.literal: Before long the stockade resident Li Shijie seized Yong and brought him out to surrender. When he was brought before the commander, Yong would not submit and was killed together with Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the stockade resident Li Shijie seized Yong and brought him out to surrender. When he was brought before the commander, Yong would not submit and was killed together with Zhen.

sentences.zh: 丁好禮，字敬可，真定蠡州人。

translations.literal: Ding Haoli, style name Jingke, was a native of Li County in Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Haoli, whose style name was Jingke, was from Li County in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 精律算，初試吏於戶部，辟中書掾，授戶部主事，擢江南行台監察御史，復入戶部為員外郎，拜監察御史，又入戶部為郎中，升侍郎。

translations.literal: Skilled in law and calculation, he first tried office in the Ministry of Revenue, was recruited as a Central Secretariat aide, appointed director in the Ministry of Revenue, promoted to investigating censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, returned to the Ministry of Revenue as vice director, appointed investigating censor, again entered the Ministry of Revenue as director, and was elevated to vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled in law and calculation, he first entered service in the Ministry of Revenue, was recruited as a Central Secretariat aide, and appointed director in that ministry. He was promoted to investigating censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, returned to the Ministry of Revenue as vice director, appointed investigating censor again, then director and vice minister.

sentences.zh: 除京畿漕運使，建議置司於通州，重講究漕運利病，著為成法，人皆便之。

translations.literal: He was appointed transport commissioner of the capital region, proposed establishing an office at Tongzhou, studied carefully the benefits and harms of canal transport, set them down as established regulations, and everyone found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed transport commissioner of the capital region, proposed establishing an office at Tongzhou, studied carefully the benefits and harms of canal transport, set them down as established regulations, and everyone found the system convenient.

sentences.zh: 除戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was appointed Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 時國家多故，財用空乏，好禮能撙節浮費，國家用度，賴之以給。

translations.literal: At a time when the state faced many troubles and finances were exhausted, Haoli could curtail wasteful spending, and the state's expenditures relied on him to be met.
translations.idiomatic: At a time when the state faced many troubles and finances were exhausted, Haoli curbed wasteful spending, and the state's expenditures relied on him to be met.

sentences.zh: 拜參議中書省事，遷治書侍御史，出為遼陽行省左丞，未行，留為樞密副使。

translations.literal: He was appointed participant in the affairs of the Central Secretariat, transferred to supervising secretary, sent out as left vice councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, but before he departed was retained as vice director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed participant in the affairs of the Central Secretariat, transferred to supervising secretary, and sent out as left vice councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, but before he departed was retained as privy council vice director.

sentences.zh: 至正二十年，遂拜中書參知政事。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Zhizheng he was appointed associate administration councilor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1360 he was appointed associate administration councilor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時京師大饑，天壽節，廟堂欲用故事大宴會，好禮言：「今民父子有相食者，君臣當修省，以弭大患，燕會宜減常度。

translations.literal: At a time of great famine in the capital, on the Emperor's Birthday the court wished to hold a great banquet by precedent. Haoli said, "Now fathers and sons among the people are eating one another. Ruler and ministers ought to examine themselves to quell this great calamity; feasts should be reduced below the usual scale."
translations.idiomatic: At a time of great famine in the capital, on the Emperor's Birthday the court wished to hold a grand banquet by precedent. Haoli said, "Now fathers and sons among the people are eating one another. Ruler and ministers ought to examine themselves to quell this calamity; feasts should be scaled back below the usual level."

sentences.zh: 」不聽，乞謝事，乃以集賢大學士致仕，給全俸家居。

translations.literal: " His advice was not heeded. He requested to retire and was made grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies with permission to retire, receiving full salary while living at home.
translations.idiomatic: " His advice was not heeded. He requested to retire and was made grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies with permission to retire, receiving full salary while living at home.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒扈從皇太子還京，輸山東粟以遺朝貴，饋好禮麥百石，好禮不受。

translations.literal: Köke Temür escorted the crown prince back to the capital and sent Shandong grain as gifts to court nobles. He presented Haoli with a hundred piculs of wheat, but Haoli would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temür escorted the crown prince back to the capital and sent Shandong grain as gifts to court nobles. He presented Haoli with a hundred piculs of wheat, but Haoli refused it.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，復起為中書平章政事，尋以論議不合，謝政去，特封趙國公。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was recalled as chief councillor of the Central Secretariat. Before long, because his views did not accord with others, he resigned from office and was specially enfeoffed as Duke of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In 1367 he was recalled as chief councillor of the Central Secretariat. Before long, because his views did not accord with others, he resigned and was specially enfeoffed as Duke of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 大明兵入京城，或勉其謁大將，好禮叱之曰：「我以小吏致位極品，爵上公，今老矣，恨無以報國，所欠惟一死耳。

translations.literal: When the Ming army entered the capital, some urged him to call on the commander. Haoli rebuked them, saying, "I rose from a petty clerk to the highest rank and was enfeoffed as a grand duke. Now I am old and regret that I have nothing with which to repay the state—all that remains is one death."
translations.idiomatic: When Ming forces entered the capital, some urged him to call on the commander. Haoli rebuked them, saying, "I rose from a petty clerk to the highest rank and was enfeoffed as a grand duke. Now I am old and regret that I have nothing with which to repay the state—all that remains is one death."

sentences.zh: 」後數日，大將召好禮，不肯行，舁至齊化門，抗辭不屈而死，年七十五。

translations.literal: " Several days later the commander summoned Haoli. He refused to go and was carried to Qihua Gate, where he spoke defiantly without yielding and died, aged seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: " Several days later the commander summoned Haoli. He refused to go and was carried to Qihua Gate, where he spoke defiantly without yielding and died, aged seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 是日，中書參知政事郭庸亦舁至齊化門，眾叱之拜，庸曰：「臣各為其主，死自吾分，何拜之有！

translations.literal: That same day, Associate Administration Councilor Guo Yong was also carried to Qihua Gate. The crowd shouted at him to bow. Yong said, "A minister serves his own lord—death is my allotted portion. What bowing is there!
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Associate Administration Councilor Guo Yong was also carried to Qihua Gate. The crowd shouted at him to bow. Yong said, "A minister serves his own lord—death is my allotted portion. What bowing is there!

sentences.zh: 」語不少屈而死。

translations.literal: " He spoke without yielding in the least and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He spoke without yielding in the least and died.

sentences.zh: 庸字允中，蒙古氏，由國學生釋褐出身，累遷為陝西行台監察御史，與同列劾知樞密院事也先帖木兒喪師，左遷中興總管府判官。

translations.literal: Yong's style name was Yunzhong. He was a Mongol who entered office through the National University, was promoted by stages to investigating censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, and together with his colleagues impeached Privy Council Director Yesan Temur for losing the army and was demoted to assistant magistrate of the Zhongxing Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yong, whose style name was Yunzhong, was a Mongol who entered office through the National University. He was promoted by stages to investigating censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate and, together with his colleagues, impeached Privy Council Director Yesan Temur for losing the army and was demoted to assistant magistrate of Zhongxing Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其後也先帖木兒以罪黜，召拜監察御史，累轉參政中書，其節義與好禮並云。

translations.literal: Later Yesan Temur was dismissed for crime. Yong was recalled and appointed investigating censor, promoted by stages to participant in the Central Secretariat. His integrity and righteousness are spoken of together with Haoli's.
translations.idiomatic: Later Yesan Temur was dismissed for his crimes. Yong was recalled and appointed investigating censor, promoted by stages to participant in the Central Secretariat. His integrity and righteousness are spoken of together with Haoli's.
